name: Anastasia Hoshin
original_name: アナスタシア・ホーシン
source:
One of the candidates for the royal election to become the 42nd King of Luginca. She is the head of the famous Hoshin Trading Company and has billed as second coming of Hoshin of the Wilderness for her near unprecedented success. Anastasia likes when people benefit while she benefits, despite her greed and lust for money as an orphan, and is actually sympathetic. She hails from Kararagi which lies west of Lugnica, where its inhabitants speak in kansai dialect; Anastasia is no exception.

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Re:Zero_-Starting_Life_in_Another_World-_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
